minor.issue: Marks messages read by reading the conversation and then writing back the whole array with $set messages. A message sent between the find and the update (rider, customer or other staff) is overwritten and lost. Use an atomic update instead: update_one({id}, {$addToSet: {'messages.$[m].read_by': uid}}, array_filters=[{'m.read_by': {$ne: uid}}]). Same risk applies wherever else the messages array is rewritten.

With $lte plus client-side dedup, if more than 'limit' (30) notifications share the exact same 'at', 'Voir les plus anciennes' would never move forward. Theoretical only; could page on (at, id) instead.
